articleText:
[Hacker News — github.com]
PDF tools for your AI agent — and for you. Pure Rust. Runs locally. Files never leave your machine.

PaperPilot is a PDF and document toolkit written in Rust. The same engine runs as:

1. Use it with your coding agent (MCP) Codex, Claude Code, Kimi Code, and current Pi releases connect to the same local stdio server. See the coding agent setup guide for each client's configuration and verification steps. Builds from this source can also print ready-to-merge configuration:

paperpilot-mcp --client-config codex # Also: claude-code, kimi-code, pi, claude-desktop, cursor Download paperpilot-mcp from Releases , then add it to claude_desktop_config.json :

{ "mcpServers" : { "paperpilot" : { "command" : " /path/to/paperpilot-mcp " } } } Restart Claude and try: "Merge these two PDFs and compress the result."

# Merge paperpilot merge --inputs doc1.pdf doc2.pdf --output merged.pdf # Compress paperpilot compress --input in.pdf --quality 75 --output compressed.pdf # Rotate pages 1, 3–5 by 90° paperpilot rotate --input in.pdf --pages 1,3-5 --angle 90 --output out.pdf 3. Use it in the browser Go to usepaperpilot.com . Open your browser's Network tab while you work — you'll see no file uploads.

git clone https://github.com/KrushnaVardhanReddy/PaperPilot.git cd PaperPilot cargo build --release -p paperpilot-cli -p paperpilot-mcp -p paperpilot-gateway Desktop app:

cd apps/desktop && pnpm install && pnpm tauri dev Requires Rust 1.75+, Node.js, and pnpm.

Organize: merge, split, rotate, delete pages, reorder pages, extract pages, booklet imposition, N-up grid Optimize: compress Extract: plain text, OCR (pure-Rust PaddleOCR via rten ) Security: watermark, validate signatures, remove signatures, PII scan, deep sanitize Office data: Excel → JSON, Excel → CSV

Private by default. Everything runs locally or in your browser tab. Agent-ready. MCP support is first-class, not an afterthought. One engine, many surfaces. CLI, MCP, REST, WASM, and desktop share the same Rust core, so behavior is consistent. Small and dependency-light. Pure Rust, built on lopdf , pdf_oxide , rten , and friends. Benchmarks Run cargo bench --workspace to reproduce. Methodology and results: SYSTEM_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md .

Desktop (Tauri) · CLI · REST (Axum) · MCP (stdio) · WASM (browser / edge) │ Rust core workspace paperpilot-core · paperpilot-pdf · paperpilot-nlp · paperpilot-gateway paperpilot-mcp · paperpilot-wasm · paperpilot-storage Embed in your own site < script src =" https://cdn.usepaperpilot.com/embed.js " data-tools =" merge,compress,ocr " > </ script > < div id =" paperpilot-widget " > </ div > Local REST API paperpilot serve --port 7823 curl -X POST http://localhost:7823/api/v1/pdf/merge \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"inputs": ["a.pdf", "b.pdf"], "output": "out.pdf"} ' Swagger docs at http://localhost:7823/docs .

Issues and PRs are welcome. Good first contributions: bug reports with a sample PDF, new tool requests, and docs fixes.

Community Edition (this repo): Apache 2.0 . It includes the CLI, MCP server, REST gateway, WASM engine, and desktop app.

An Enterprise Edition (SSO, RBAC, audit logs, DLP) is developed separately.
